categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily manufactures and sells garden machinery equipment, including lawn mowers, brush cutters/grass trimmers, and other power machinery with various power sources (gasoline, AC electric, and lithium-ion battery). The company operates through multiple business segments including product design, manufacturing, and sales, with both ODM (Original Design Manufacturing) and OBM (Original Brand Manufacturing) models.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including gasoline engine design and manufacturing, lithium-ion battery management systems, intelligent control technology, and electric motor engineering. Production methods include precision manufacturing with quality control systems, modular platform standardization for products, and integration of smart features such as electronic braking, automatic height adjustment, and AI-powered navigation for robotic lawn mowers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major international retailers and distributors such as The Home Depot, Walmart, Kingfisher Group, Husqvarna Group, and Makita Corporation. The company serves both professional landscaping and residential consumer markets across Europe, North America, Australia, and other developed regions, with products sold in over 70 countries and territories.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in North America, Europe, Australia, and Asia. It maintains production facilities in China (headquarters in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province), Mexico, Austria (through AL-KO acquisition), and the United States. Subsidiaries include operations in Germany, Hong Kong, Thailand, Singapore, and Mexico, with 97.86% of 2024 revenue from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain, functioning as a manufacturer and distributor of finished garden machinery products. It sources raw materials and components from suppliers, manufactures products through its own facilities and contract manufacturers, and distributes directly to major retailers and distributors globally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include transitioning to new energy products (lithium-ion battery-powered equipment), developing intelligent and automated solutions (robotic lawn mowers with AI navigation), expanding global manufacturing footprint, and enhancing product platforms for standardization. R&D focuses on 62V and 40V lithium-ion platforms, zero-turn radius riding mowers, robotic mowers with advanced sensors, and multi-functional cordless tools.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured garden machinery products to international retailers, distributors, and brand manufacturers. Revenue is recognized upon product delivery and customer acceptance. The company operates on both ODM basis (manufacturing products designed by customers) and OBM basis (selling products under its own brands such as MOWOX and Green Machine).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading ODM manufacturer in the global garden machinery industry and a domestic market leader in lawn mower production. Major competitors include Husqvarna Group, Makita Corporation, Techtronic Industries (TTI), and MTD Products. The company holds significant market share through relationships with major global retailers and maintains competitive advantages through innovation and manufacturing scale.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-to-large sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 1.761 billion yuan, representing 89.67% growth from 2023 revenue of 928.5 million yuan. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 16.1 million yuan in 2024 compared to a loss of 174.9 million yuan in 2023. Total assets reached 3.33 billion yuan at year-end 2024, with 968 employees including 250 research and development personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through advanced product innovation including lithium-ion battery technology platforms, intelligent control systems, ergonomic design, and comprehensive product portfolios. Key differentiators include zero-turn radius riding mowers, AI-powered robotic lawn mowers with visual navigation, multi-functional cordless tool platforms, and extensive international certifications (CE, EPA, ETL, RoHS, etc.). The company emphasizes environmental sustainability, user convenience, and technological leadership in the garden machinery sector.
